title: UNI Wilson College of Business celebrates online MBA graduates
summary_en: Graduates of UNI’s online Master of Business Administration crossed the stage at the 2026 spring Commencement. The program attracts a wide variety of students, ranging from young professionals to seasoned business executives seeking the highly regarded MBA from the Wilson College of Business.
title_cn: UNI Wilson College of Business celebrates online MBA graduates

title: Pella Corporation’s Adam Farver to headline the 2026 Iowa Family Business Conference at Vermeer Corporation in Pella
summary_en: The family behind Pella Corporation, one of Iowa’s most iconic multigenerational companies, will headline the 2026 Iowa Family Business Conference in Pella on Nov. 11.
title_cn: Pella Corporation’s Adam Farver to headline the 2026 Iowa Family Business Conference at Vermeer Corporation in Pella
